packageRules.description: Keep OpenVox Forge updates separate and manually reviewed

Don't let Renovate bump go.mod's own `go` directive - it's pinned to match CI's toolchain (see .github/workflows), and Renovate bumping it alongside an unrelated dependency update breaks the build (seen live 2026-09-08, PR #311: x/sync bump silently carried go 1.25.2 -> 1.26.0)
